courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: Slocum 水下滑翔機
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以走時到垂直深度建立起點，接到船位姿態時間對齊的系統介面，最後用點雲缺口和品質旗標整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Travel time to vertical depth, connect through Position/attitude time alignment, then integrate evidence using Point-cloud gaps and quality flags. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 科學海床多音束測繪
history.text: 本專題以走時到垂直深度建立起點，接到船位姿態時間對齊的系統介面，最後用點雲缺口和品質旗標整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Travel time to vertical depth, connect through Position/attitude time alignment, then integrate evidence using Point-cloud gaps and quality flags. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 把聲速剖面、姿態、時間戳和扇幅幾何連接到海床點雲品質，避免只看彩色地形漂亮與否。 在多音束點雲與聲速資料室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Connect sound-speed profiles, attitude, timing and swath geometry to seabed point-cloud quality rather than visual appearance. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Multibeam point-cloud/sound-speed laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
